title: Henry of Navarre, La Rochelle, 10 July 1586: news-sheet to Ségur, BnF 500 de Colbert 401 f. 333, in the f. 321 key (Tomokiyo)

steps.what: Gallica IIIF fetched with a browser User-Agent.
Whole volume swept (440 canvases): cipher on six leaves; f. 321 (key letter with interlinear decipherment) and f. 333 are Tomokiyo's 'Henry III' pair.
f. 333 transcribed at 2x from the full-resolution IIIF image (ct_333.txt).

f. 333 decrypted with Tomokiyo's f. 321 table; the reading forces 24 = f (frere), 34 = l (il, montera), 36 = m (comment) and 61 = et; the key is the ff. 233 key's design with letters shifted by eight and h/j rows added.
Free annealer on f. 333 alone fails (below unicity); matched control of the same size fails likewise.

Design-constrained annealer re-derives the f. 333 letter key blind under the alphabetical-design assumption: 54 of 58 letter tokens (93.1 %) against key_321.json, syllable rows weak (7 of 16 blocks); matched alphabetical control 90 %.

f. 321 at 2.4x and 3x, and strike-through removal tried: the decipherer's stroke runs through every figure, so no transcription independent of the interlinear is obtainable; recorded as Tomokiyo's ground truth.

Split from segur under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): f. 333 was read with Tomokiyo's f. 321 key, a different key from ff. 233/239/288v; its own entry. ct_333.txt, key_321.json, henryiii_figure.png and the f. 333-size controls moved here.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): transcription ct_333.txt; decryption produced by running targets/segur/decode.py with key_321.json, saved as texts/f333_decryption.md; key key_321.json

Reading audit, per-document pass (George Lasry's sentence test): f. 333 read on the raw decode and on the normalised reading in NOTES.md. The cipher runs build French sentences with the five name codes open (blocked: no key material); per-document C overturned to B. Claim unchanged.
Read bar applied per document (v10): 1 of 1 documents marked read measure under 95% of words read as sense (v2_score explicit holes) and are now read in part; read_share recorded for each.

outcome.method_basis: f. 333 was decrypted with Tomokiyo's key reconstructed from the f. 321 interlinear decipherment (published before the attempt), extended here by four values; a blind design-constrained re-derivation agrees on 93 % of the letter tokens but is not the source of the reading.
outcome.fraction_read_source: ct_333.txt with key_321.json (letters 12-62, syllables 63-142 in 16 rows, 162 = Le Roy de Navarre): 108 numeric tokens, 103 with a value; 5 open name codes (204, 189, 190, 166, 167). Five figures confirmed as written disagree with the French (slips).
outcome.notes: f. 333 read with Tomokiyo's f. 321 key: the reistres, Navarre to mount on horseback, the levy to march; five name codes open. f. 321 itself not re-transcribed (struck through).

credits.note: key reconstructed from the f. 321 interlinear decipherment (cryptiana henryiii.htm), applied to f. 333 and extended by 24 = f, 34 = l, 36 = m, 61 = et

texts.label: La Rochelle, 10 July 1586 (BnF 500 de Colbert 401 f. 333)
texts.summary: A news-sheet in the third person signed Henry at La Rochelle, 10 July 1586, sent to Ségur: the King of Navarre wants news and advice on the road he should take, and will mount as soon as the reiters march; the levy must be hastened and set marching as soon as possible. The clear parts report Mayenne's army, the plot at Montauban, Drake's raids, and Vesin de la Marsillière's mission to Berne.

reading_review.note: Overturns the per-document C. texts/f333_decryption.md is the raw decoder output, but the normalised reading in NOTES.md (section f. 333) builds French sentences: "[162] desire fort d'avoir des nouvelles de [204] de [189] [190] ... et leur advis sur le chemin [qu'i]l doit tenir ... [167] assurer qu'aussi tost que les reistres marcheront il montera a cheval; [166] et son frere sont de bonne volonte; il fault avancer la levee et la faire marcher". The holes are the five name codes (no key material) and one run after [190]; the clear text is abridged with ellipses.

texts.note: 24 Oct 2026: 94.8% of the words of texts/f333_reading.md read as sense (v2_score explicit holes); coherent sentences but under the 95% read bar, so read in part.

prior.where: Tomokiyo's key reconstructed from the f. 321 interlinear decipherment, on cryptiana before the attempt; no plaintext of f. 333 found.

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
